design_decisions.decision: Flag on Database (last_error_timed_out) rather than parsing last_error text; read via getattr so FakeDatabase needs no change.
Limit shown is DB_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (5s) for all in-connect timeouts, including the 10 s create_pool wait_for backstop; one wording rather than separate connect limit.
Also converted TimeoutError in the rule/watchlist load path to the timed-out line, since a lock on a table hit there previously escaped with no startup line.
30 s line reworded from "after Ns" to "(startup limit Ns)" to parallel the other; existing test only checks "timed out".
